purpose: Source and display instructions to retrieve actual CC-licensed or public-domain wildlife photographs from Wikimedia Commons/Wikipedia at visitor runtime, with licence metadata and artist credit. Photos are not user-supplied original Dubbo photographs.
validation: Runtime image metadata must be checked before publication. Image searches and Wikipedia lead images are automated candidate matches, not manually verified biological identifications. No 89-image success guarantee until live visual review.
photo_policy: Never claim the represented animal is personally observed in Dubbo. Exact taxon and historical lineage may remain unverified.
